xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Company received an Order levying a penalty of Rs. 12,383/- under Section 85(B) of the Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The Order has been passed alleging delay/non payment of wages for December, 2010 in due time.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The financial impact of the Orders is to the extent of the penalty levied. There is no impact on the operations or other activities of the Company due to the Orders.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: The Company received an Order levying a penalty of Rs. 20,000/- under Section 73 of the Gujarat Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 read with Section 20 of Integrated Goods and Service Tax Act, 2017.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: The Order has been passed alleging input tax credit availment on cancelled dealers invoice & GSTR3B non-filers during the financial year 2021-22.
